text:
Aisha: Quick stand-up for the launch narrative + SEO work — we need final keyword/semantic targets, schema, internal links, redirects, and the lead-routing tags before the benchmark blog + webinar go live. Who can take what?

Marco: I'll own keyword mapping and messaging alignment with the benchmark. Proposed canonical for both blog and webinar landing: /benchmarks/inference-economics. Primary KW focus: "inference economics", "latency vs cost", "LLM serving benchmarks". Use long-tail phrases in H2s: "how to lower inference cost without raising latency".

Dylan: Redirects & canonicalization: I'll push a Netlify PR with 1:1 301s and set rel=canonical on staging. Draft _redirects: 
```
/benchmarks/old-inference-report  /benchmarks/inference-economics  301
/webinars/inference-econ-2025     /webinars/inference-economics     301
/posts/inference-costs-draft      /benchmarks/inference-economics  301
```
Preserve query params for UTMs. No chains.

Priya: Structured data: Event + BlogPosting + FAQ. Minimal JSON-LD for blog head: 
```json
{ "@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"BlogPosting","headline":"Inference Economics: Benchmarks & Playbook","datePublished":"2026-05-10","author":{"@type":"Person","name":"Redwood Team"} }
```
Add FAQ for: "Will you share raw benchmark data?" and "Is this applicable to private deployments?"

Aisha: Inbound routing: use UTM_campaign=benchmarks_inference_may. Hidden form fields: utm_campaign, source=benchmark_blog. HubSpot workflow: tag leads with benchmark_inference, mark as MQL if site_time >3 min AND submitted form, assign to growth SDRs if company_size > 25.

Marco: Internal linking plan: add contextual links from /docs/inference/overview, the new benchmarks hub, and two high-traffic posts about latency patterns. Use anchor text variations: "inference economics", "serving benchmarks", "reduce inference cost". Add a small banner CTA on docs pages.

AutoSEO: Crawl scheduled at 2030003600 — will check: missing canonical, redirect chains >1 hop, schema errors, and broken internal links.

Dylan: I'll open the redirect PR at 09:30 PT with the preview + redirect-checker output. Priya, can you paste full JSON-LD into the blog head? Marco, update H1/H2 with the KW variations. Aisha, update launch board owners.

Aisha: Sounds good. Hold any newsletter/email sends until AutoSEO passes. Thanks team :rocket:
